meta.heading: Two follow-ups: code blocks, and where new Desk cards land
meta.intro: Round 22 is two cards. Both are plans with pictures; neither is built yet. What you approved in round 21 is being built now and your answers are under Done. Press one of the two buttons on each; a note is optional.

r22-today-row.area: The Desk · from your 26 October approval
r22-today-row.title: A Today row for new cards on the Desk
body: On 26 October you approved a **Today row**. On 10 November the Desk changed another way: a new card now takes the next free spot after all the others, so nothing gets shoved. That works, but with a full Desk the next free spot is at the bottom right (first picture: what I logged today is half off the edge).
The Today row (second picture) puts what you log today at the top, right of the toolbox, where you are looking.
bullets: The one trade-off: each morning, yesterday's cards drop down to join **Earlier**. Nothing moves during the day.
Cards you placed yourself never move, exactly as now. Boxes and drawers are untouched.
where: In Shiftbook, open the **Desk** with more than a dozen cards on it.
Press Ctrl+Space, type **30m test card** and press Enter.
Look for the new card: it is at the end of the last row, often past the right edge.

figures.caption: Now: the entry I just logged (orange outline) lands bottom right, half off the edge. A second one is fully out of view.
With a Today row: today's cards along the top, everything older under Earlier.
